items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: You know, I did a thing with Nelson Riddle a few months ago and they had two guitarists and Lee Ritenour was there

ctx.x: About 21. He looks like he's 12. You know, I did a thing with Nelson Riddle a few months ago and they had two guitarists and Lee Ritenour was there, and I was just thrilled to hear him. I feel proud of him, you know, and I really do. This is how I feel about him because they contribute and they inspire me, you know. So we have a wonderful crop of young guitarists coming up now, and it's exciting. I enjoy it very much.
